caption: The drawing features a detailed colored illustration and technical schematic of an upholstered seat. The upper section shows a perspective view of a wooden-framed settee or loveseat with a tufted, oval-shaped backrest and a wide, cushioned seat. The upholstery is bright pink with button tufting on the backrest, and the seat has a smooth finish. The frame is rendered in brown, with a carved floral crest at the top of the backrest and ornate, curled leg supports. Beneath this view, there is a colored horizontal detail of the wooden carving, prominently featuring a central flower flanked by scrolling leaf patterns. Below this, two technical side and front elevation diagrams are present. They are drawn in black ink with measurements clearly labeled in inches, showing side and front profiles of the seat, including detailed dimensions such as the height, width, depth, and thickness of various components. The artist's name, WELLINGTON BLEWETT, is typed in the lower right corner. The background of the entire drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Sofa
